name: UAL 122 左发失效 重启成功

cards.audioText: B: You are parking at the apron and ready for taxi, please request taxi clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你停在停机坪，准备滑行，请求滑行许可。

cards.audioText: C: United 122, stand by, snow removal is in progress.
C: United 122, taxi via taxiway Bravo 2, Bravo and Echo 3 to holding point runway 34.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 122，经滑行道 Bravo 2、Bravo 和 Echo 3 滑行至跑道 34 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway B2, B and E3 to holding point runway 34, UAL122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 B2、B 和 E3 滑行至跑道 34 等待点，UAL122。

cards.audioText: B: Please call Tower, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：呼叫塔台，报告准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: United 122, line up and be ready for immediate departure.
C: United 122, cleared for takeoff, report airborne.
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, report airborne, UAL122.

cards.audioText: B: You are at 1000 feet now, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在 1000 英尺，联系离场。
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场，UAL122，通过 1000 英尺爬升中。

cards.audioText: C: United 122, Departure, follow Golf Juliet 2 Delta departure, expect no further instruction until 3000 feet, after 3000 feet, join your planned route.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 122，离场，执行 Golf Juliet 2 Delta 离场，3000 英尺前预计无进一步指令，过 3000 英尺后加入计划航路。
cards.referenceText: Follow GJ 2D departure, expect no further instruction until 3000 feet, after 3000 feet, join planned route, UAL122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 GJ 2D 离场，3000 英尺前预计无进一步指令，过 3000 英尺后加入计划航路，UAL122。

cards.audioText: C: United 122, expedite climb to keep separation, traffic is in your 2 o'clock converging, report when clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 122，加快爬升以保持间隔，2 点钟方向有汇聚航空器，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Expedite climb to keep separation, report when clear of traffic, UAL122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加快爬升以保持间隔，脱离冲突后报告，UAL122。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller that you keep well clear of the traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已与该航空器保持安全间隔。
cards.referenceText: Departure, UAL122, clear of the traffic.

cards.audioText: C: United 122, continue climbing to FL250, proceed to Hotel Mike, contact Control on 122.10 when reaching FL120.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 122，继续爬升至飞行高度层 250，飞往 Hotel Mike，到达飞行高度层 120 时联系管制 122.10。
cards.referenceText: Continue climbing to FL250, proceed to HM, contact Control on 122.10 when reaching FL120, UAL122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 FL250，飞往 HM，到达 FL120 时联系管制 122.10，UAL122。

cards.audioText: B: You are at FL120, call Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在飞行高度层 120，呼叫管制。

cards.audioText:
C: United 122, can you lose time on route? Landing delays at Oscar Bravo Oscar Airport.
B: Tell the controller that you can.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 122，你能在航路上消耗时间吗？Oscar Bravo Oscar 机场落地延误。
B：告诉管制员可以。

cards.audioText: C: United 122, reduce your speed to Mach point 65, maintain FL250.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 122，减速至马赫 0.65，保持飞行高度层 250。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to M.65, maintain FL250, UAL122.

cards.audioText: B: You tell the controller that your port engine is inoperative.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你们左发失效。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Control, UAL122, our port/left engine has failed.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，管制，UAL122，我们左发失效。

cards.audioText:
C: United 122, roger PAN call, report your current status.
B: You have shut down the engine and are trying to restart it following the checklist.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 122，收到 PAN 呼叫，报告当前状态。
B：你已关闭左发，正在按检查单尝试重启。
cards.referenceText: We have shut down left engine, we are trying to restart it, UAL122.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们已关闭左发，正在尝试重启，UAL122。

cards.audioText:
C: United 122, roger.
B: Engine restart are unsuccessful, you want priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：United 122，收到。
B：发动机重启不成功，你希望优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Control, UAL122, engine restart are unsuccessful, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，UAL122，发动机重启不成功，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: United 122, turn left heading 170 and descend to 3000 feet, contact Approach on 130.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：United 122，左转航向 170，下降至 3000 英尺，联系进近 130.6。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 170, descend to 3000 feet, 130.6, UAL122.
